# cws-mcp

> MCP server for Chrome Web Store extension management. Upload, publish, and manage Chrome extensions from any MCP-compatible AI agent.

## Tools (9)

- upload: Upload a ZIP file to Chrome Web Store (updates existing item draft)
- publish: Submit/publish with publish type, rollout percentage, skip-review, and blockOnWarnings
- status: Fetch current status including review state, deploy percentage, and version
- cancel: Cancel a pending submission
- deploy-percentage: Set staged rollout percentage (0-100, must exceed current target)
- get: Alias of status; v2 publication status, not listing text. projection is rejected
- get-metadata-ui: Read current draft description, category, homepageUrl, and supportUrl from the dashboard
- update-metadata: Save those four supported draft fields through the dashboard and verify persisted values
- update-metadata-ui: Alias of update-metadata

## Install

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cws-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "cws-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "CWS_CLIENT_ID": "xxxxx.apps.googleusercontent.com",
        "CWS_CLIENT_SECRET": "GOCSPX-xxxxx",
        "CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN": "1//xxxxx",
        "CWS_PUBLISHER_ID": "me",
        "CWS_ITEM_ID": "your-extension-id"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Environment Variables

- CWS_CLIENT_ID (required): Google OAuth2 Client ID
- CWS_CLIENT_SECRET (required): Google OAuth2 Client Secret
- CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN (required): OAuth2 Refresh Token
- CWS_PUBLISHER_ID (optional): Publisher ID, defaults to "me"
- CWS_ITEM_ID (optional): Default extension item ID
- CWS_DASHBOARD_PROFILE_DIR (optional): Browser profile path for UI automation, defaults to ~/.cws-mcp-profile

## API Coverage

Covers all Chrome Web Store API v2 endpoints: media.upload, publishers.items.publish, publishers.items.fetchStatus, publishers.items.cancelSubmission, publishers.items.setPublishedDeployPercentage. Listing text uses Playwright dashboard automation because v2 has no listing-text API. No v1 requests remain.

## Notes

- deploy-percentage only works for extensions with 10,000+ seven-day active users
- Rollout percentage must always increase (never decrease)
- Dashboard tools require Google Chrome and first run with headless=false for login
- Dashboard reads/updates target the current draft/localization, not published listing text
- category must match the visible option label exactly; English and Korean field labels are supported
- Saving never submits for review. Missing fields, unselected categories, or failed readback return errors
- title, summary, defaultLocale require manifest/localized-message edits and a rebuilt ZIP via upload
- Raw metadata and storeIconPath are unsupported; use the Developer Dashboard for icons/screenshots
- STAGED_PUBLISH holds publication after approval; deployPercentage controls gradual rollout separately
- Set blockOnWarnings=true to stop on validation warnings; default false, inspect warningInfo.warnings
